parameter_axis.semantic_rule: q is a normalized coordinate; each execution carries the mapped physical duration

fixed_recipe.geometry_contract: full-cup side-wet initial continuum box, retained cup/receiver/tray floor, four fixed catchment walls, top open
fixed_recipe.continuous_surface_contract: catchment floor is the retained tray boxfill=bottom source plane z=-0.20 m; wall shell thickness is numerical only
fixed_recipe.initial_mass_policy: native rho*dp^3 with no mass rescaling

event_window.right_censor_policy: 5 s is the registered qualification window; a right-censored required event fails the cell and no further extension is permitted

events.definition: prescribed cup angle reaches -105 degrees at 0.50 + duration(q) s
valid native fluid mass inside the one-dp-clear receiver interior first reaches 1% of initial fluid mass
valid native fluid mass outside the cup, receiver and tray observation volumes first reaches 1% of initial mass; missing identities remain a separate integrity failure
after motion completion, speed p95 <= 0.10 m/s and kinetic energy <= 5% of initial gravitational potential for 0.20 s continuously
motion, receiver contact and settled are observed, with 0.35 s of saved output after the last required transition

event_window.development_canary_exclusion: the 2.5 s DBC canary and its one-time 5 s extension are evidence for launch readiness only and cannot populate a qualification cell

independent_interior_policy.spatial: q=.25 and .75 held-out rows are independent interior checks at dp=.0075 and .005
independent_interior_policy.temporal: q=.5, dp=.0075 controls are comparator rows and do not replace spatial interiors
independent_interior_policy.canaries: 2.5 s and 5 s q=.5, dp=.0075 DBC canaries are excluded from all 15 rows

failure_policy.hard_or_event_failure: retain the failed row and denominator; no threshold or ownership relaxation
failure_policy.five_second_right_censor: candidate insufficient; no additional horizon extension
failure_policy.f1_fallback: review the recorded F1 H1/H2 negative evidence before proposing any distinct mechanism
